_doc: How a run difference (run A minus run B, one product, one grid, one valid time) is coloured. Read by rustwx-render/src/difference.rs. The bar is symmetric about zero with `bands` equal bands; the `neutral_bands` nearest zero take the neutral colour, so a difference smaller than one band reads as no difference. The half range is the table row for the product in the units it is drawn in; with no row, it is the `percentile` of the absolute difference over the cells where the difference is defined, rounded up so one band is a 1, 2 or 5 step. A theme's own `colormaps.diverging` replaces `colors`. One field is differenced and overlays are dropped. It is the field the title names: the fill, or, for a product that fills one field and contours the field its title names (`MSLP / 10m Winds` fills the 10 m wind speed and contours MSLP), the contoured field the product declares, in the units its contours are drawn in. A product that draws overlays is titled by the field subtracted: the field it declares, its `titles` row, or else its title up to the first ` / `.
